business_rule: As a system, I want to ensure that a session is marked as modified when data is changed, so that the session cookie is written to the response only when necessary.
As a system, I want to return a null session if the session support cannot be loaded due to a configuration error, so that the application can handle session lookups without crashing.
As a system, I want to set the session cookie only if the session has been modified or if it is permanent and the SESSION_REFRESH_EACH_REQUEST config is true, so that unnecessary cookies are not set.
As a system, I want to return an expiration date for the session if it is permanent, so that the session can expire after a defined period.
As a system, I want to delete the session cookie if the session is empty and modified, so that stale session data is not retained.
As a system, I want to check if the session is a null session to skip saving it, so that unnecessary operations are avoided.
As a system, I want to use the SESSION_COOKIE_NAME config to determine the name of the session cookie, so that the cookie can be correctly identified.
As a system, I want to use the SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN config to determine the domain for the session cookie, so that the cookie is sent to the correct domain.
As a system, I want to use the SESSION_COOKIE_PATH config to determine the path for which the cookie should be valid, so that the cookie is only sent for the appropriate paths.
As a system, I want to use the SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY config to determine if the session cookie should be httponly, so that the cookie is protected from client-side access.
As a system, I want to use the SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE config to determine if the cookie should be secure, so that the cookie is only sent over HTTPS.
As a system, I want to use the SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE config to determine the SameSite attribute for the cookie, so that the cookie's cross-site request behavior is controlled.
As a system, I want to use the SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED config to determine if the cookie should be partitioned, so that the cookie's storage is managed according to privacy requirements.

As a developer, I want the dump method to serialize data as JSON and write it to a file, so that data can be stored in a standard format.

As a system, I want to ensure that the data deserialized from a file must be read in text mode or binary mode with UTF-8 bytes, so that it remains valid JSON.
